# Vendored ilamy calendar

Source: https://github.com/kcsujeet/ilamy-calendar

Pinned revision: `04e34d17cb6db097c034bba04655353bcc38fe7c`

Calendar core, recurrence plugin, shared types, UI primitives and configured date utilities are copied from this revision. Test fixtures and unrelated plugin entrypoints are excluded. The MIT license is retained beside this file. Application integration lives in `src/`; donor rendering and recurrence algorithms are unchanged.
